reader_core_setup: Select the reader devices in Core Extensions configuration and explicitly approve their event access before activating this version.
reader_scope_notice: A scan records entry, pause or resume. It does not open a door, confirm physical passage, finish a stay or create a charge.
reader_toggle_ids: Reader IDs (one per line, up to 16)
reader_effective_policy: Saving starts a new policy from now. Older queued events will be recorded without changing stays. Use the reader IDs shown in activity; devices and reader IDs are different.
reader_settings_changed: Reader settings changed. Refresh before saving.
reader_ids_invalid: Provide distinct reader IDs for the selected mode.
reader_devices_missing: Select reader devices in Core before enabling scan processing.
i_confirm_local_registration_of_these_co: I confirm registration of these contacts and children. When staff opens a Barsy account, the parent name and contacts are sent to Barsy; stay quantities and permitted orders are recorded there.
finishing_stops_time_tracking_for_this_s: Finishing stops time tracking for this stay.
finish_all_active_stays_before_erasure_t: Finish all active stays before erasure. Technical history remains; downloaded copies and backups require separate handling.
i_reviewed_the_actual_saved_records_unkn: I reviewed the actual saved records. Unknown does not mean cancelled.
unknown_outcome_review_the_saved_records: Unknown outcome. Review the saved records before continuing.
names_and_at_least_one_contact_are_requi: Names and at least one contact are required
only_a_pending_registration_can_be_appro: Only a pending registration can be approved
bracelet_is_empty_or_already_assigned: Bracelet is empty or already assigned
child_already_has_an_active_stay: Child already has an active stay
no_active_stay_or_clock_moved_backwards: No active stay or clock moved backwards
clock_moved_backwards_refresh_before_con: Clock moved backwards; refresh before continuing
stay_is_already_in_the_requested_state: Stay is already in the requested state
request_id_was_reused_with_different_dat: Request ID was reused with different data
subject_exceeds_the_bounded_inline_expor: Subject exceeds the bounded inline export; a paginated export is required
Subject exceeds the bounded inline export
barsy_setup_in_core: Configure the connection using the settings gear for Child Center in Core Extensions. After saving, review access and activate the application.
barsy_read_only: These are explicit directory reads. No account, order or payment is created; nothing is sent automatically.
barsy_unavailable: Barsy is unavailable. Check Core connection settings and approved access, then try explicitly again.
barsy_invalid_response: Barsy returned invalid directory data. No partial result was accepted.
bracelet_preview_unavailable: Bracelet could not be identified. Check it and scan again.
scan_changed: The bracelet or stay changed. Scan again before confirming.
sofia_time: Dates and times use Europe/Sofia. Date filters select the day the stay started.
historical_snapshot_notice: This stay predates the detailed timeline. Earlier pauses and resumptions cannot be reconstructed; the saved time is preserved.
invalid_stay_dates: Choose a valid stay date range.
fullscreen_unavailable: Fullscreen is unavailable in this browser. Registration remains available.
client_changed_refresh_before_saving: Client changed; refresh before saving. Your edits have been retained for comparison.
correction_must_preserve_existing_childr: Correction must preserve the existing children
commerce_interactive_notice: Each Barsy change is prepared and sent explicitly. Unconfirmed results must be checked; never repeat the change in Barsy.
commerce_consumption_confirmed: Consumption added to the family bill.
commerce_payment_confirmed: Payment confirmed. The family bill is closed.
commerce_time_zero: The measured stay time is zero; no time sale is needed.
commerce_parent_attestation: I recorded the parent's explicit permission for these articles.
commerce_registration_choices: Select only articles the child may order. No selection means no child consumption permission; guardian orders remain separate.
commerce_payment_notice: Barsy determines the payable amount. Cash and independently confirmed card payments are supported.
commerce_received_confirmation: I confirm this amount was received by the selected method. This does not run a card terminal.
commerce_external_attestation: I checked this exact account and its result in Barsy.
commerce_release_unlinked_hint: Use only for finished stays without any account-opening attempt. The old parent request and history are retained; an existing Barsy client is neither changed nor deleted.
commerce_release_unlinked_attestation: I accept archiving this request without a bill; the old parent request may have created a client in Barsy.
commerce_unlinked_release_denied: Archiving requires finished stays, no account or account-opening attempt, and no charges or payment attempts.
commerce_unlinked_archived: This finished request was archived without creating a bill. Its history is preserved.
commerce_parent_attempt_retired: The old parent attempt was archived without replay. Check the exact registration code in Barsy; change the parent details before any new creation attempt.
commerce_release_empty_hint: Close the exact empty account in Barsy first. This action only checks it and archives it locally; it creates no order or payment. History is preserved.
commerce_release_empty_attestation: I verified the empty closure in Barsy and accept that this test stay will not be charged.
commerce_empty_release_denied: Release requires the exact closed, empty Barsy account, finished stays and no acknowledged or confirmed charges.
commerce_empty_released: The empty account was released locally without charging the test stay. Its history is preserved.
commerce_send_confirmation: I reviewed this step and authorize one send to Barsy.
commerce_reconcile_account_id: Barsy account ID (only if the opening reply was lost)
commerce_configuration_notice: Choose articles and places from the Barsy directory, then save. Use a fixed-quantity time article with a compatible unit; Barsy timers must be off. Configuration is locked while accounts are unsettled.
commerce_validation_required: The account checks have expired or changed. Continue the prepared step to validate it again before sending.
commerce_delivery_not_sent: The request was not sent to Barsy. The step remains prepared; check the connection and continue when ready.
commerce_unavailable: Barsy is unavailable or the operation budget was exceeded. Check the journal before continuing.
commerce_invalid_remote: Barsy returned data that cannot be safely verified.
commerce_denied: This action requires a current account with the explicit application permission.
commerce_parent_code_unavailable: Barsy did not return the linked client code. Check the API user rights for client codes, then continue opening.
commerce_parent_code_mismatch: The Barsy client code belongs to a different registration. Review the linked client code.
commerce_parent_not_found: Barsy did not find a client with this registration code. Review the linked parent in Barsy.
commerce_parent_id_mismatch: The registration code points to a different Barsy client than the saved link. Review the linked parent.
commerce_parent_name_mismatch: The parent name in Barsy differs from the registration. Correct the data, then continue opening.
commerce_parent_phone_mismatch: The parent phone in Barsy differs from the registration. Correct the data, then continue opening.
commerce_parent_email_mismatch: The parent email in Barsy differs from the registration. Correct the data, then continue opening.
commerce_identity_conflict: The remote identity does not match. Review the exact client or account in Barsy.
commerce_stale: Data changed. Refresh and review before preparing again.
commerce_accounts_pending: Settle existing accounts before changing commercial configuration.
commerce_invalid_settings: Choose distinct valid articles and places from the directory.
commerce_parent_permission: The parent has not permitted this child consumption article.
commerce_client_unavailable: The registration must be approved and available.
commerce_not_ready: Configure commerce and confirm the account opening first.
commerce_parent_required: Synchronize the current parent details first.
commerce_place_busy: This place has an open or unconfirmed account. Choose another place.
commerce_finish_first: Finish the local stay and confirm its time before payment.
commerce_pending: Finish or verify the existing prepared or uncertain step first.
commerce_invalid_quantity: Quantity must be positive and match the article precision (at most 100).
commerce_quote_expired: The amount, method, actor or quote validity changed. Cancel any unsent payment and obtain a new amount.
commerce_not_found: The journal step was not found.
commerce_no_cancel: Only an unsent prepared step can be cancelled.
commerce_remote_closed_or_timer: The account is closed or a Barsy timer is enabled. Review it in Barsy.
commerce_article_unavailable: The article is unavailable or its unit is incompatible. Time in hours requires at least three decimal places.
commerce_check_required: Verify this result using Check result. Do not send the change again.
commerce_account_id_required: Find the exact account in Barsy and enter its account ID.
commerce_manual_review_required: The send acknowledgement was lost. Review the exact result in Barsy and confirm that review.
commerce_invalid_payment: The amount, base currency or payment methods cannot be safely used. Review payment directly in Barsy.
commerce_review_limit: This account exceeds the bounded 1000-step verification limit. Review its journal before a separate supported recovery.
commerce_settings_unsaved: Selection changed. Save changes to apply it.
commerce_consent_save_hint: To enable Save changes, confirm the parent permission above.
commerce_other_role_action: A staff member with the appropriate permission must handle this action.
live_stay_time_notice: Active time updates locally and is approximate. Refresh to synchronize changes made elsewhere.
commerce_default_place_hint: Entry opens a separate bill for each family at this place. Barsy time calculation must be off.
commerce_guardian_category_required: Choose the parent consumption category in Barsy settings first.
commerce_finish_family_confirmation: Finish all listed stays. Reentry will be unavailable until this bill is settled.
commerce_opening_synchronizing: Synchronizing the parent with Barsy. The family bill will open automatically; this view checks its progress.
commerce_opening_opening: Opening or verifying the family bill in Barsy. This view checks its progress; no duplicate bill is sent.
commerce_guardian_catalog_hint: Products for the parent come from the configured Barsy category and are added to the shared family bill.
commerce_auto_opening_setup: Automatic opening requires a default place in Barsy settings and a family stay. Older unlinked stays require explicit account opening.
commerce_opening_review: Account opening needs attention. Review pending actions, then continue. Do not create another bill in Barsy.
commerce_legacy_bills: This family has several older bills. Settle them before starting a new family bill.
commerce_checkout_started: This family's checkout has started. Settle the current bill before starting another stay.
reader_result_account_review: The family bill needs review before another stay can start.
pending_check_hint: The result is not confirmed yet. Check the saved result before continuing; this does not resend the change.
app_debug_mode_hint: Show detailed procedure steps, technical identifiers and diagnostic messages. Normal mode keeps the main actions and genuine errors. Applies after saving; other open pages read it on refresh.
app_settings_stale: Application settings changed. Refresh before saving.
unconfirmed_operation: The result could not be confirmed.
